title: docs(audit): the devDep count is 6, not 5
body:
My error in #2975. The addendum table said "**5**, not 6" and then listed **six** package names.

Six is correct, verified against main: `plugin-list` and `data-objectstack` gained the devDependency in #2974, but the body's original count of 6 came from a 13-package "needs a guard" list that omitted `fields` — which also lacks it. So removing two and adding one leaves six.

```
plugin-charts      MISSING
plugin-dashboard   MISSING
plugin-report      MISSING
components         MISSING
mobile             MISSING
fields             MISSING
plugin-list        HAS   (#2974)
data-objectstack   HAS   (#2974)
```

The number scopes the parity-guard prerequisite in #2941/#2942, so a wrong one misplans that work.

Docs-only, one line.
